```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
```

Link to dataset: 
https://www.movebank.org/cms/webapp?gwt_fragment=page=studies,path=study4901146318

Remember as_date is to convert POSIXct object to Date format

```{r}
as.POSIXct("2026-10-24 14:30:00")

as_date(x)
# "2026-10-24"
as.Date(x)       # Base R
lubridate::as_date(x)  # lubridate

format(as.Date(x), "%d/%m/%Y")
# "24/10/2026"

as.Date(x, tz = "Europe/London")
```


```{r}
locations <- read_csv("./data/White-bearded_wildebeest_2017_2021.csv") |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(date = as_date(timestamp))|>
  select(date,individual_local_identifier,
         location_long,location_lat)
head(locations)
```

```{r}
locations_grouped<-locations|>
  group_by(individual_local_identifier,date)|>
  summarise(
    Longitude=median(location_long,na.rm=TRUE),
    Latitude=median(location_lat,na.rm=TRUE)
  )
head(locations_grouped)
```

```{r}
min_lon_wb <- locations_grouped |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

print(min_lon_wb)
max_lon_wb <- locations_grouped |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()

print(max_lon_wb)

min_lat_wb <- locations_grouped |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

print(min_lat_wb)

max_lat_wb <- locations_grouped |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()

print(max_lat_wb)

```

```{r}
ggplot(locations_grouped,aes(x=Longitude,y=Latitude,
                             colour=individual_local_identifier))+
  geom_point(size=3)+
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon_wb - 0.1, max_lon_wb + 0.1),
    ylim = c(min_lat_wb - 0.1, max_lat_wb + 0.1)
  )+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  ggtitle("White-bearded wildebeest movement - \nGreater Mara Ecosystem (2017-2021)")+
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

library(colorspace)
ggplot(locations_grouped,aes(x=Longitude,y=Latitude,
                             colour=individual_local_identifier))+
    geom_point(size=3)+
    annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
    coord_quickmap(
        xlim = c(min_lon_wb - 0.1, max_lon_wb + 0.1),
        ylim = c(min_lat_wb - 0.1, max_lat_wb + 0.1)
    )+
    scale_colour_discrete_qualitative(
        palette = "Pastel 1",
        nmax = 12
    )+
    ggtitle("White-bearded wildebeest movement - \nGreater Mara Ecosystem (2017-2021)")+
    xlab("Longitude (°)") +
    ylab("Latitude (°)") +
    theme_minimal()
```
